messages:
maya: Deploy finished for feature/metrics-index -> prod at 11:05 PT. Rolling to 100% (was 3 nodes -> 5). Watching health for the next 15m.
deploy-bot: Deploy job #4821 succeeded. All deploy steps passed. Services reported READY in 18s. :white_check_mark:
Tom: I’ll kick the smoke checklist now. Running quick health + inference sample against a repro prompt.
li: Noted — will pull metrics and retention traces. If error-rate spikes >0.5% ping me.
Tom: Smoke cmds: `curl -sS https://api.prod.redwood.ai/health | jq .status` then a sample generation:```bash
http POST https://api.prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate Authorization:"Bearer $PROD_KEY" input='{"prompt":"Summarize: Redwoods are...","max_tokens":40}'
```
Tom: sample run returns 200 and snippet looks sane (no tokenization errors). Latency ~150ms.
li: Metrics snapshot: p50 generation 120ms, p95 340ms, errors 0.21% (small blip during rollout). KV-cache hit rate steady at 82%. No obvious anomaly in request distribution.
maya: Good. Anyone see database connection count abnormality or slow RPCs?
infra-oncall: Scanning infra: no elevated DB connections beyond expected warm-up. Minor spike in background batch jobs while scaling nodes up, but recovered. CPU on gpu-pool-2 peaked at 74% then normalized. No OOMs.
Tom: I found one minor log error in router at 11:06 - `WARN: retryable grpc error` — retried and succeeded, so not user-facing. Marked in the deploy notes.
li: Keeping a watch window for 20m. If errors >0.5% or latencies exceed p95 600ms, we revert to previous model replica set.
maya: Thanks. Rollback readiness: @infra-oncall can you confirm rollback playbook is staged?
infra-oncall: Rollback playbook staged and validated, snapshot created at 11:04 PT. I’ll be ready to execute within 5m if needed.
Tom: I'll update the release checklist: toggled routing fallback to model-v1-stable, alerts on.
maya: OK — if no one raises a blocker in the next 15m we call this verified and close the release ticket. Leave short notes in the ticket about the retry warning and the small error blip.
li: Adding metrics graphs to the ticket and tagging SRE/Observability.
Tom: quick note: ran full smoke suite locally against prod for pepper tests — all green. :thumbsup:
maya: Great work — staying on standby for the rest of the watch window.
